column11: Passage

Holding the line
Under splitting pressure
Of possible future

What’s left behind,
On the road leading here
Is now just a soil
For whom shall follow

Drowning slowly,
In the thoughts of days that past…
Through the vague and turbid air,
Her very self in outbursts of light and shadows.
Moment of clarity

Upside down
She lay trying to sense her own blood
Washing thoughts away
Tempting darkness

Endless race
To gain a world
Just to give it up
With your name on it

Down the path of only witness,
One that’s left, when your eyes
wide shut.

Through veil of time,
In repeated lapses of acts of kindness,
Light prevails

Serene, within
The shadows of the thoughts.., watching
Sun, going through the body
Of it’s waters.

From the water we have came,
Into the water we shall go.
Dream catcher

Within the life
She wanted to purse
The one
She is living

There she laid,
Drowning her breath.
Ticking ambiance

Your thoughts disowned,
Each one of them striking waves
Of collective ego, punishing, for
The liberty of having them

Scraps of reminiscences,
Blasting through her mind like an electrical current
Winding matter

Pealing time, off all the scatter,
To a layer, where we, quite simply, know, Accept, understand and anything else is just irrelevant.
Taking a risk, of going bare,
You yourself a manifest of what and why it is,
Heart beating to affirm a single truth,
That you would’ve not taken it
Any other way.

Her shadow trembling
Like a curtain to an outside reality
Thin baffle

In tired violence
Underneath ones skin
There is an end and the beginning
Looking to surrender

Among the things
That are our food, comfort, entertainment, profit, delusion of forward movement,
How much of it is our life?

Dissected by darkness, light..
Through his reflection’s negative,
Laughing abyss

Freedom to choose
To hold on
To your own music

A little drop
A tiny step
Right through the heart
Of her cassette
Playing on repeat
And simply falling
Over and again
The curtain of tomorrow

Gravity of things we truly loved,
Growing through a skin
Of who we came to be
Places we come to see and things we leave in them — when the time curls up there is nothing else, but those; neither there is any escaping it.

Atop the surface wide and clear,
They stood observing order of the new.
One by the name of Dark.

Not expecting a call
Silence so dense you could slice it
Only her face still holding
An expression from a different time

A trigger pulled..,
Seeing it through.
From now to the end of forever.

In the wast viscous darkness
A glimpse of longer than there will ever be
Watching us

Same old friend,
burning thoughts of younger time
With everything to lose
Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.

Reaching out, touching faith
One religion, broadcasting answer
So simply and so vividly

Darkness asking,
To repeat an oldest story.
Hanging on,
To see a turn anew

Looking back, to see the future
The bubble of your own paradigm

Dropping masks and closes, leaving
fears by the door and coming naked
before all the versions of who you’ve been.

How few is left
Of this Autumn
And ghostly aims afar

Of thought not mine
Just guesses
Seen in full, to the dregs

How scary and sneaky
Your revelations
For why is grinning while whine.
Of dreams unsung, sweet moments
Shout - shout - shout

A book we read to remember
Fixations we have of the past
To find a mark, setting us free

Be it God, or fate or soul
Only fire, will be watching
Your slowly.., melt, control.

Sundance of moonly shadows
Come around
Once again

Doors we open to forget,
Stranger things we saw;
Others - lost and said..,
What, are we waiting for
